title: Framework Metadata
description: Schema for individual framework metadata files in data/frameworks/. Each *.json file (excluding this _schema.json) describes how a single compliance framework is rendered, scored, and identified in the CheckID registry.

frameworkId.description: Stable lowercase-kebab identifier. Must match the filename stem.

label.description: Human-readable framework name shown in UI.

description.description: One- or two-sentence description of the framework's purpose.

homepageUrl.description: Authoritative source URL for the framework.

css.description: CSS class prefix used by consumers for framework-specific styling.

totalControls.description: Total count of controls/practices/techniques in the framework.

registryKey.description: Key used in registry.json check entries to reference this framework.

csvColumn.description: Column header in framework-mappings.csv that holds this framework's mapping.

displayOrder.description: Sort order for UI rendering (lower = earlier).

method.description: Scoring strategy. Method-specific fields (profiles, maturityLevels, criteria, tactics, requirements, functions, policies, severities) are permitted via additionalProperties.

colors.description: Optional top-level light/dark theme colors. Some frameworks (CIS) declare colors per scoring profile instead.
